productLaunches.title: Dex Semantics
productLaunches.description: Let your agent build analytics with 25% fewer errors - Dex Semantics adds declarations to your analytical models, which capture row meaning, join nature, how numbers add up, and decisional assumptions. Thanks to this, Dex scores 80% on ADE-bench with Claude Sonnet 5.5, compared to 73.3% without Dex (25% fewer tasks failed). Declarations live in your models as code, not a third-party tool. Dex then helps your agent convert declarations into your Semantic Layer of choice.

Wikilinks, backlinks, search, daily notes, a graph on the Mac. Sync ($5.99/mo) keeps Mac and iPhone the same and lets your AI read and write your notes over MCP.

sourceItems.title: CaptureFlow
sourceItems.description: Open-source screen recorder with instant share links - Record your screen with the Chrome extension and share a link with your team or customers. Your AI agents can record too, through the MCP server: demos, how-tos and bug reports.

sourceItems.title: Kokonut UI
sourceItems.description: Open-source UI components for your AI agent - Kokonut UI is a free, MIT-licensed library of 100+ React components made for coding agents. Connect through MCP in Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or Codex, ask for "a tool approval card in my chat", and your agent finds the component, installs it and edits it in your repo. Every docs page is also served as Markdown for agents. This release adds 65 components and rebuilds 34, led by AI chat parts: tool calls, tool approval, diff review, citations and more.
